design: There is a known fix: write the main part of each piece in class under supervision, keep drafts, and have a short talk with the pupil about it. The £18,000 and spare teacher periods cover it, and the trade-offs are mild. A careful answer can meet every test.
tests_hint: Tests: who does the checking and by when, how much it costs against £18,000, a way for a pupil to show their own work. Limits: no pupil punished on a detector tool's score alone; no extra work that falls on pupils without a laptop or quiet place at home; no spend over the budget.
angles: Supervised writing in class plus a short talk about it
Buy a tool that scores every essay for AI use
Ban all computers for coursework and go back to exams
